 사진 확대 ‘2026 MAMA.’ Photo: Screenshot from Mnet’s YouTube channel The group IVE won Best Female Group at the ‘2026 MAMA AWARDS.’
 Chapter 1 of the global K-pop awards ceremony ‘2026 MAMA AWARDS (2026 MAMA Awards)’ was held at 6 p.m. on the 20th at Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan.
 Taking the stage right after winning the award that day, IVE shared their thoughts: “We love our fans so much. We met fans around the world through our world tour this year, and we’ll work to create many more opportunities to meet fans around the world. We’re grateful that we can create a positive influence and music, and we’ll make sure we have a positive influence on many people going forward.”
 The concept of the ‘2026 MAMA AWARDS’ is ‘Music Interstellar (A MUSIC INTERSTELLAR).’ It depicts a journey of drifting among the stars of music, crossing boundaries of time and space, generations, and tastes, and discovering and sharing music from different eras. The awards ceremony is being livestreamed around the world in real time on major digital platforms, including Mnet Plus.
 [Lee Da-gyeom, Star Today reporter]
